description.value: A cozy, light-filled art gallery in the heart of Qualicum Beach showcasing Canadian talent from emerging and local creators. The space emphasizes community connection and curated exhibitions, making it a pleasant stop for a touring cyclist looking to stretch their legs and take in some local culture on Vancouver Island.

address.value: 152 2nd Avenue West, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2T7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Oceanside Art Gallery' but the website at oceansideartgallery.ca clearly identifies the business as 'Vibe Arts' (page title, footer copyright '© 2026, Vibe Arts', and contact email heather@vibe-arts.ca), indicating a likely rebrand. The OSM phone (+1 250 594-3344) is confirmed on the website footer alongside a second number (250) 228-4554. The address '152 2nd Avenue West, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2T7' on the website matches the OSM address. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, or any other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned on the website.
concerns: Major name mismatch: OSM lists 'Oceanside Art Gallery' but the website identifies the business as 'Vibe Arts' with email heather@vibe-arts.ca and footer '© 2026, Vibe Arts'
Website lists a second phone number (250) 228-4554 not present in OSM
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business appears to have rebranded from 'Oceanside Art Gallery' to 'Vibe Arts' — the OSM name and domain no longer match the on-site branding. The gallery itself is a legitimate attraction for touring cyclists in Qualicum Beach, but the name discrepancy should be resolved and none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) could be confirmed.

wow_evidence: Small local gallery of Canadian/local creators; ordinary gallery 1/1.
blurb: Small downtown gallery showing local and Canadian artists.
